_why: Ceilings for the whole bridge in 2026 on a mid-range laptop GPU, shared with the city tiles. Draw calls bind first in WebGL: ~1,500/frame at 60 fps on an Iris Xe/GTX 1650/M1-class laptop, every shadow-casting mesh is drawn twice, and the tiles take several hundred, so the bridge gets 300 (~600 with shadows). Triangles: 1 M here plus the tiles, doubled by the shadow pass, is ~3-4 M/frame, comfortable on that class. Merge geometry (mergeGeometries) before adding meshes. baseline = main at 2026-11-01 (d26ce4f): [draw calls, triangles] per part id, for the deltas in the check table; update it when you land a deliberate spend.
